"""Independent current-framework controls; not an implementation of the proposal."""
import asyncio, importlib.abc, json, sys, tempfile
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

class NoApplicationImports(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
 def find_spec(self,fullname,path=None,target=None):
  if fullname.split('.')[0] in {'apps','scripts','experiments'}:raise ImportError('Application/experiment import prohibited in neutral probe')
sys.meta_path.insert(0,NoApplicationImports())
from devtools.agents.conversation import Conversation,ConversationMessage,ConversationMessageRole
from devtools.context import Repository,RepositoryResourceAddress,observe_repository_resources
from devtools.context.planning import choose_whole_resource_disclosure,plan_disclosures,materialize_disclosure_plan,render_context_disclosure,assemble_context_disclosure_model_request
from devtools.core.paths import resolve_path
from devtools.core.time import Timestamp
from devtools.execution import Runtime
from devtools.models.interaction import InteractionSource,ModelRequest,ModelResponse,ModelToolCall,ModelToolDefinition,Prompt,PromptMessage
from devtools.resources.commands import Command,CommandExecutor
from devtools.resources.filesystem import TextFile,write
from devtools.tools import ToolDescriptor,ToolRunner
from devtools.tools.filesystem import ReadRepositoryFileTool
from devtools.tools.command import CommandTool

class NeutralInteraction:
 source=InteractionSource('independent-neutral-fixture')
 def __init__(self):self.requests=[]
 async def send(self,request):
  self.requests.append(request)
  if len(self.requests)==1:return ModelResponse('Read the literal source.',self.source,tool_calls=(ModelToolCall('read_repository_file','{"path":"lib/answer.py"}','read-one'),))
  assert request.prompt.messages[-1].role=='tool'
  assert request.prompt.messages[-1].tool_call_id=='read-one'
  assert request.prompt.messages[-1].content=='def answer():\n    return 7\n'
  return ModelResponse('The independently read function returns seven.',self.source)

async def main():
 rows=[]
 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='devtools-neutral-architecture-') as directory:
  root=resolve_path(directory);source=resolve_path(root.value/'lib/answer.py');source.value.parent.mkdir()
  text='def answer():\n    return 7\n';write(TextFile(source,text),overwrite=False)
  snapshot=observe_repository_resources(repository=Repository.new(),root=root,addresses=(RepositoryResourceAddress('lib/answer.py'),),maximum_resource_bytes=4096)
  choice=choose_whole_resource_disclosure(purpose='Verify the literal answer source',snapshot=snapshot,resource_address=RepositoryResourceAddress('lib/answer.py'))
  disclosure=materialize_disclosure_plan(plan=plan_disclosures(purpose='Verify the literal answer source',snapshot=snapshot,disclosures=(choice,)),snapshot=snapshot)
  assert disclosure.items[0].native_provenance.content==text
  descriptor=ToolDescriptor('read_repository_file','Read the one trusted fixture path',json.dumps({'type':'object','properties':{'path':{'type':'string','enum':['lib/answer.py']}},'required':['path'],'additionalProperties':False}))
  # Deliberate caller composition: the existing framework has both values but
  # no public cross-domain normalizer. This is not a new reusable adapter.
  definition=ModelToolDefinition(descriptor.name,descriptor.description,descriptor.input_schema_json)
  model=NeutralInteraction();request=ModelRequest(Prompt('',role='messages',messages=(PromptMessage('user','Inspect the trusted answer function.'),)),tools=(definition,))
  response=await model.send(request);assert response.source==model.source;call=response.tool_calls[0]
  arguments=json.loads(call.arguments_json);assert arguments=={'path':'lib/answer.py'}
  read=await ToolRunner().execute(ReadRepositoryFileTool(root),resolve_path(root.value/arguments['path']));assert read.content==text
  followup=ModelRequest(Prompt('',role='messages',messages=(*request.prompt.messages,PromptMessage('assistant',response.content,response.tool_calls),PromptMessage('tool',read.content,tool_call_id=call.provider_call_id))),tools=(definition,))
  final=await model.send(followup);assert final.content=='The independently read function returns seven.' and len(model.requests)==2
  command=Command(sys.executable).args('-c','from pathlib import Path; text=Path("lib/answer.py").read_text(); assert text == "def answer():\\n    return 7\\n"').cwd(root)
  checked=await ToolRunner().execute(CommandTool(CommandExecutor()),command);assert checked.exit_code==0
  rows.append(dict(id='neutral-native-existing-composition',expected='Two normalized invocations, exact read and correlated Tool result, one host-fixed real check; no application imports',observed=dict(model_calls=2,read_text=read.content,tool_call_id=call.provider_call_id,check_exit=checked.exit_code,usage=asdict(final.usage) if final.usage else None,snapshot=str(snapshot.id)),classification='CURRENT_CAPABILITIES_WORK_WITH_EXPLICIT_HOST_COMPOSITION_NOT_MIGRATION_PROOF'))
  simple=NeutralInteraction();conversation=Conversation.new()
  retained=await Runtime().send(conversation=conversation,interaction=simple,message=ConversationMessage.new('Inspect the answer.',role=ConversationMessageRole.USER,source=InteractionSource('trusted-fixture-host')))
  assert simple.requests[0].prompt.messages==() and simple.requests[0].tools==() and len(retained.tool_calls)==1
  assert len(conversation.history)==2 and conversation.history[-1].content=='Read the literal source.'
  rows.append(dict(id='runtime-native-surface',expected='Current Runtime sends text without native Tool declarations and retains communication only; no Tool execution',observed=dict(prompt_role=simple.requests[0].prompt.role,structured_messages=len(simple.requests[0].prompt.messages),declared_tools=len(simple.requests[0].tools),returned_calls=len(retained.tool_calls),history_messages=len(conversation.history)),classification='DELIBERATE_CURRENT_CONTRACT_NOT_NATIVE_CODING_COORDINATION'))
  try:assemble_context_disclosure_model_request(task_request=request,context=render_context_disclosure(disclosure))
  except ValueError as error:
   assert str(error)=='Text Context assembly does not accept structured message input.'
   rows.append(dict(id='structured-context-assembly',expected='Explicit refusal by text-only assembler',observed=str(error),classification='SUPPORTED_LIMITATION_EXTENSION_REQUIRES_DESIGN'))
  else:raise AssertionError('Expected documented text-only assembly refusal')
 assert not any(name.split('.')[0] in {'apps','scripts','experiments'} for name in sys.modules)
 result=dict(at=str(Timestamp.now()),python=sys.version,application_import_guard=True,rows=rows,qualifications=['Temporary literal files only; no Git checkout copy, inference, API calls or proposed production implementation.','The manual composition shows existing substrates can be used independently; it does not establish a framework coding-agent lifecycle or migration completion.'])
 (Path(__file__).parent/'probe-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
asyncio.run(main())
